products.what_it_changes: Seller (Xtrig copy): opposing dual-clamp design reduces stanchion deformation for faster fork reaction and more precise handling; bores machined after assembly; bolted steering stem.
products.caveats: Backordered 7-21 working days. Per-model fitment inferred from 'all KTM/HVA'; verify with Xtrig. Some ROCS Pro kits include PHDS bar mounts.

products.what_it_changes: Listing: clamps hold fork tubes from opposite directions to reduce inner-tube distortion and let the fork flex naturally; split clamps and opposing bolts claimed to improve fork response and precision. Includes PHDS bar mounts with 12 bar positions.
products.supporting_parts: PHDS mounts (yellow medium elastomers), 10mm spacers and stem with pre-mounted bearing included.
products.caveats: Title says 2021-2026 but CRF250R fitment starts 2022 and stops 2024 on this page.

products.what_it_changes: Listing: opposing self-locking clamp design reduces fork-tube deformation and resists twisting; adjustable offset; precision-finished bores; bolted stem; PHDS bar mounting where specified.
products.caveats: Stock status unclear (available and waitlist both shown). Hardware/offset vary by application.

products.what_it_changes: Maker page gives no offset or description.
products.caveats: Offset not stated on maker page; shown as backorder.

variants: Bar mounts: forward 12.5mm or rear 6mm ahead of stem; optional offset mount 15.5mm
products.what_it_changes: Per MXA (reporting Ride's design): split clamp adds flex for bump comfort; 23.5mm vs stock 22mm lengthens wheelbase for more stability.
products.supporting_parts: Bar mounts $104.95 and steering stem nut $34.95 sold separately.
rider_feedback: MXA (Jan 2023): more settled chassis, better under acceleration/braking bumps, more predictable; but the 2023 CRF450 still 'needs direction control'.
Keefer/PulpMX found Ride's 23.5mm the best overall option on 2023-2024 YZ450F (see Yamaha entry).
products.caveats: Fitment and price from a Jan 2023 magazine test, not the maker site (ride-engineering.com not fetchable). 2024+ Honda fitment not confirmed.

products.what_it_changes: Test (Kris Keefer): vs stock 22mm, more front-tire feel on lean, less off-throttle headshake, more balanced front end; slightly firmer in hands. Suggested fork height 3-3.5mm.
rider_feedback: Keefer rated 23.5mm Ride clamps best overall of five offsets on the 2023-2024 YZ450F.
products.caveats: No price/part number in source; maker page not fetched. Older aomc.mx listings show Ride YZ/WR clamps 10-23 (YZ-TB03N) and 20mm (YZ-TB04N) but those pages were not verified.

products.what_it_changes: Test: 23mm adds slight lean-angle and off-throttle stability; 24mm more planted on decel and mid-corner, firmer bump feel; 25mm best straight-line stability but lazy side to side, suited to fast GP/sand.
rider_feedback: Keefer: 25mm felt vague in corners; 24mm needs offset stem since Xtrig doesn't sell 24mm.
products.caveats: No price or part number in source.
